klip.lokasi: A simple, tidy Indonesian dining room before dawn: a wooden dining table in the center with a plate of rice and one glass of water, two wooden chairs, a warm hanging lamp above the table, a window on the left showing a dark blue pre-dawn sky

kamera.posisi: in front of the table at eye level, medium shot
kamera.fokus: Saheela and Ummi at the table

klip.awal: Saheela sits on the left chair at the dining table holding a spoon in her right hand over the plate of rice, one glass of water on the table in front of her; Ummi sits on the right chair beside her; both face the table at a slight three-quarter angle toward the camera, Saheela clearly smaller.

aksi.aksi: Saheela eats one spoonful of rice and puts the spoon down on the plate with her right hand.

ucapan.text: Ummi, hari ini Saheela mau puasa sampai Maghrib!

aksi.aksi: Ummi gently rests her left hand on Saheela's shoulder.

klip.akhir: Saheela and Ummi sit side by side at the table, Ummi's left hand resting on Saheela's shoulder.
klip.latar: a quiet house before dawn, crickets outside, distant roosters

foley.suara: a metal spoon placed on a ceramic plate

klip.lokasi: A bright, clean Indonesian kitchen at midday: a white two-door refrigerator on the right, light grey tiled floor, a window with sunlight on the left, a small counter in the background

kamera.posisi: beside the refrigerator at chest height, medium shot

klip.awal: Saheela stands in front of the closed white refrigerator at a three-quarter angle toward the camera, her right hand on the fridge handle; one glass of pink iced syrup stands on the middle shelf inside the refrigerator.

aksi.aksi: She pulls the refrigerator door open with her right hand and the glass of pink iced syrup is visible on the middle shelf.

klip.akhir: Saheela stands holding the open refrigerator door with her right hand, facing the glass of iced syrup.
klip.latar: a quiet house at midday, a faint refrigerator hum, distant birds

foley.suara: a refrigerator door opening with a soft suction pop

kamera.posisi: beside the refrigerator at chest height, medium shot

klip.awal: Saheela stands holding the open refrigerator door with her right hand, facing the glass of iced syrup.

aksi.aksi: She slowly closes the refrigerator door with her right hand until it shuts, then lowers her hand to her side.

ucapan.text: Eh, Saheela kan lagi puasa. Sabar!

klip.akhir: Saheela stands next to the closed refrigerator with both hands at her sides.
klip.latar: a quiet house at midday, a faint refrigerator hum

benda.letak: held open by Saheela's right hand

klip.lokasi: A cozy Indonesian living room in the afternoon: a beige fabric sofa in the center, a low wooden table in front of it, a window on the left with warm afternoon light

kamera.posisi: in front of the sofa at eye level, medium-wide shot
kamera.fokus: Saheela and Ummi on the sofa

klip.awal: Ummi sits on the right side of the sofa and Saheela sits next to her on the left; both face the camera at a slight three-quarter angle; Saheela's hands rest on her stomach, Saheela clearly smaller.

aksi.aksi: Saheela leans her shoulder against Ummi's arm.
Ummi puts her right arm around Saheela's shoulders.

ucapan.text: Sabar sebentar lagi ya, Nak. Allah cinta orang yang sabar.

klip.akhir: Saheela sits leaning against Ummi with Ummi's right arm around her shoulders.
klip.latar: a calm living room in the afternoon, a ceiling fan turning softly, distant birds

serial.pesan: Puasa dimulai dari niat dan sabar
